select t1.id,t1.card_id,t1.subsidy_type,t1.subsidy_date, t1.money,t2.`name` as userName ,t3.file_name as fileName from poor_subsidy t1 left join poor_user t2 on t1.card_id=t2.card_id left join poor_data_file t3 on t1.data_file_id=t3.id
and t1.card_id like concat('%', #{cardId}, '%') and t1.subsidy_type = #{subsidyType} and YEAR(t1.subsidy_date) = #{year}
